# Mid-Michigan NOW

> Regional news outlet covering breaking news, investigations, and community stories across Flint, Saginaw, and Mid-Michigan with focus on local issues, crime, and lifestyle features.

Mid-Michigan NOW serves the Flint-Saginaw region with comprehensive coverage of local news, weather, sports, and investigative journalism. The station maintains strong community connections through business spotlights, educational crisis coverage, and cold case investigations while also providing national and international news context.

## Key Topics

- Flint
- Michigan
- Mid-Michigan
- Genesee County
- Lapeer County
- Shiawassee County
- Local News
- Breaking News
- Crime & Safety
- Community News
- Flint Water Crisis
- Education Crisis
- Cold Cases
- Human Interest
- Business & Development

## Core News & Breaking Stories

- [Mid-Michigan NOW News, Weather, Sports, Breaking News](https://midmichigannow.com): Homepage for Mid-Michigan NOW news covering Flint-Saginaw area
- [Local](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local): Local news section aggregating breaking news and community events
- [Vernon Twp. man dies after vehicle crashes into tree and ignites into flames](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/vernon-twp-man-dies-after-crashing-vehicle-into-tree-and-ignites-into-flames): Fatal car crash in Shiawassee County; vehicle fire incident
- [Trash catches fire in garbage truck, Lapeer company warns customers about battery disposal](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/trash-catches-fire-in-garbage-truck-lapeer-company-warns-customers-about-battery-disposal): Rick Rhein Disposal warns about lithium battery disposal safety risks

## Investigations & Long-Form Coverage

- [Flint Water Crisis](https://midmichigannow.com/news/flint-water-crisis): Coverage of ongoing Flint water contamination crisis and settlements
- [Crisis in the Classroom](https://midmichigannow.com/news/crisis-in-the-classroom): Series on Michigan education crisis covering teacher salaries and shortages
- [Unsolved Mid-Michigan](https://midmichigannow.com/news/unsolved-mid-michigan): Investigative series on unsolved murders and cold cases in Flint area

## Community & Business Features

- [New In Town](https://midmichigannow.com/news/new-in-town): Coverage of new businesses opening in Lapeer County area
- [We're Open](https://midmichigannow.com/news/were-open): Local business spotlights featuring Downtown Flint restaurants and shops
- [49th Flint RV & Camping Show taking place this weekend](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/49th-flint-rv-camping-show-taking-place-this-weekend): Coverage of 49th annual Flint RV & Camping Show at Dort Financial Center
- ["Grandma hobbies:" Young people ditch doomscrolling, turn to old-school hobbies](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/grandma-hobbies-young-people-ditch-doomscrolling-turn-to-old-school-hobbies-flint-news-craft-tiktok-social-detroit-michigan-analog-vintage-sewing-knitting-crocheting): Feature on Gen-Z turning to analog hobbies like knitting and crafting

## National & Political News

- [Nation & World](https://midmichigannow.com/news/nation-world): National and international news coverage including politics and security
- [Connect to Congress](https://midmichigannow.com/news/connect-to-congress): Congressional news and political coverage from national perspective
- [Armstrong Army Strong](https://midmichigannow.com/news/armstrong-army-strong): Opinion column by Armstrong Williams on politics and current events

## Digital Content & Multimedia

- [Videos](https://midmichigannow.com/news/videos): Video clips covering national politics, government, and local news
- [Digital Desk](https://midmichigannow.com/news/digital-desk): Video series and digital content from Mid Michigan Now news team
- [Stay Connected](https://midmichigannow.com/news/stay-connected): Information on NBC25/FOX66 News App and social media connections

## Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Amazing America](https://midmichigannow.com/amazing-america): Travel and lifestyle features on American landmarks and regional exploration
- [Entertainment](https://midmichigannow.com/news/entertainment): Entertainment news covering TV shows, celebrities, and pop culture
- [Offbeat](https://midmichigannow.com/news/offbeat): Quirky and viral stories featuring unusual news and human interest
